At the end of 2018, GEO600 set another world record.

In doing so, it made a key step towards third-generation observatories like the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer.

GEO600 reached a squeezing level of 5.7 dB, suppressing the quantum background noise by a factor of almost 2, and increasing the volume of the observable Universe by a factor of 7.
